title: From Rs 60 a day to national award: Delhi teacher Suman Goel's 22-year journey
description: Suman Goel began teaching for just Rs 60 a day in 2004 to help fund her college education. Twenty-two years later, the former student of a Delhi government school has been selected for the National Teachers’ Award 2026. Now a primary teacher at the same school, Goel has focused on foundational learning, inclusion and student well-being, supporting children from disadvantaged backgrounds and students with special needs. Her journey highlights how personal struggles can shape an impactful teaching career.

title: In 2013, Angelina Jolie’s search for 'work inspiration' led her to a WWII veteran

This connection led her to direct 'Unbroken', chronicling his incredible wartime saga. Following a plane crash, Zamperini faced a grueling 47 days stranded at sea before becoming a POW for two years. Jolie was driven by a profound duty to depict his remarkable life story authentically.

title: Shafali scripts history, becomes fastest and youngest to reach 3,000 T20I runs
description: At just twenty-two years and 220 days old, Shafali Verma made history by becoming the youngest player ever to score 3,000 runs in T20 internationals. She also claimed the title for the fastest to reach this milestone in terms of balls faced. In a decisive match, India easily chased down Pakistan's meager total of fifty-six, securing a resounding seven-wicket victory.

title: India crush Pakistan by 7 wickets after spin attack bundles them out for 55
description: In a stunning performance, India triumphed over Pakistan by seven wickets during their Group A encounter. Pakistan struggled significantly, managing a mere 55 runs, marking their lowest T20I score. India's spinners dominated, with Shree Charani leading the charge by taking three wickets. Shafali Verma made history by surpassing 3,000 T20I runs. With this victory, India completed the group stage undefeated and confidently secured a semi-final berth.

Terrorism and proxy war are central to Pakistan's strategy towards India. Future warfare demands faster adaptation and integration across all domains. India must raise the cost of proxy war and terrorism for Pakistan.

This practice undercuts required wages and creates unfair competition for American workers. USCIS stated its action protects American workers and maintains program integrity. The immigration authority emphasized correct position classification under the H-1B system.

Officials noted that the deaths cannot be attributed to a single pathogen at this time. A total of 431 children received treatment, many of whom have since recovered. The administration has also supplied additional Measles-Rubella vaccines and purified water sources.

Ganguly highlighted the difficulty for subcontinent fast bowlers to sustain careers. Shami is currently aiming for an international recall after a strong domestic showing. His captain Ishan Kishan praised Shami's hunger and determination on the field.

title: Nepal floods show the risk; China's mega-dam raises bigger questions for India
description: Recent Nepal floods highlight Himalayan vulnerabilities and cascading disaster risks. China's Yarlung Tsangpo dam project faces scrutiny due to its geologically unstable location. The dam's operation could influence downstream river flows and water security for India. Chinese scientists have warned about the project's seismic and landslide risks in the region. India faces managing combined risks from infrastructure, climate change, and border proximity.

With a string of impressive achievements including record-breaking performances in the IPL and his international debut, this match will test his versatility and endurance, pushing him to adapt to the demands of longer cricket formats.

title: Travis Kelce grows business empire with $53m hydration deal
description: Travis Kelce expanded his growing business portfolio by joining organic hydration company Recover 180 as an investor and brand partner. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end highlighted the importance of quality hydration for peak performance and recovery. The move added to his partnerships across fashion, fitness, food and lifestyle brands. At the same time, Kelce remained focused on football, making it clear that winning another Super Bowl was his biggest goal.

title: Judge orders cull of 2,500 mule deer introduced to Catalina Island in 1920s
description: Catalina Island's mule deer, released in the late 1920s, now pose serious threats to local flora and contribute to increased wildfire risks. In response, conservation leaders have outlined a contentious strategy to significantly reduce the mule deer population. Following a legal challenge that was dismissed by a judge, the cull is set to commence, aimed at preserving the island's natural environment and lowering fire hazards.

title: Why Larry Page let cofounder Sergey Brin choose Google-parent Alphabet's name
description: Google, founded by Larry Page and Sergey Brin, has expanded significantly beyond its search engine origins. The company now operates under Alphabet, a parent structure for diverse technological ventures. Larry Page chose the name Google, while Sergey Brin selected Alphabet for the parent company. This organizational change allowed for a separation of core Google services from other innovative projects.

These unrestricted donations empower universities to allocate funds as needed. Her extensive philanthropic efforts support various educational and community initiatives.
